v4.9.069 - the pen: one colour, honest undo, and drawings that count as work

#334 The app was listening to the pen several times over. The fullscreen undo
     button re-attached the listening after every press, and so did the resize
     handler on every rotation or window drag, with nothing ever detaching. So
     after five undos each stroke was recorded five times: thicker rougher
     lines, undo removing one copy of five and looking like it did nothing, and
     growing lag. Self-feeding, since undoing was what added another listener.
     A canvas is now listened to once.
#335 A drawing counts as unsent work. Strokes change in place and the watcher
     looks for a replaced object, so a drawing was never flagged - a pull
     arriving before the next push could bring back rubbed-out strokes or lose
     new ones. The scribble layer had said so for a while; the drawing layer
     never did.
#336 One pen colour for the whole app. It was per frame, with a second copy of
     its own inside fullscreen that nothing else knew about, two different
     defaults, and a sync in the background emptied the whole list back to
     white mid-session. Now: pick red, draw red everywhere, across a sync and
     across a restart, until you pick something else.
